answer: Like ships that must each dock at a harbor in person, every identity faces unpredictable live roll-calls: at random moments the network summons each agent to answer a fresh challenge within seconds. A single operator cannot answer for many identities at once, because each response demands live attention and computation in the same narrow window — the cost grows with every fake identity and cannot be batched, shared, or precomputed. An onyx seal stamped at each roll-call and a copper token of attendance build a chain of presence no script can fake in bulk.
